reason: The lock comes from Sensei LMS core (not in this repo) checking the lesson prerequisite set on the translated course; the theme and wporg-learn plugin only call Sensei_Lesson::is_prerequisite_complete(), so the likely cause is the Spanish lesson prerequisite settings (for example pointing at an untranslated lesson or a quiz that must be passed), which needs a check of the site data or a logged-in reproduction that cannot be done read-only.
